name: Southwest Tennessee Community College
academic_ranking: Public two-year community college in the Tennessee Board of Regents system; offers associate degrees and certificates with transfer pathways to four-year institutions. FAFSA/Federal School Code 010439. Not nationally ranked as a research university (community college; no traditional academic ranking).
financial_aid: 2025-26 tuition & fees: $5,217/yr for Tennessee residents (in-state), $18,537/yr for out-of-state. Financial aid includes federal aid, state aid, scholarships, Tennessee Promise, Tennessee Reconnect, Federal Work Study, and grants. Cost of Attendance and Net Price Calculator available on the college site. As an NJCAA member, athletics-based aid is governed by NJCAA rules.
facilities_notes: Dedicated softball facilities page on the athletics site (/sports/sball/facilities) returned HTTP 404 as of 2026-07; no public facilities description found. Athletics campus located at 5983 Macon Cove, Memphis, TN 38134 (Macon Cove campus).
program_reputation: NJCAA / TCCAA (NJCAA Region VII) women's softball program at Southwest Tennessee Community College (Saluqis). 2025-26 roster is small (12 players) and heavily local, drawing primarily from West Tennessee and northern Mississippi high schools (Memphis, Munford, Millington, Covington, Dyersburg, Olive Branch MS, Aberdeen MS, etc.). No head coach or assistant coaches are currently listed publicly, suggesting the coaching staff may be in transition or not yet posted.
notes: Coaching staff data checked live 2026-07-30. The softball Coaches page (https://athletics.southwest.tn.edu/sports/sball/coaches/index, HTTP 200) has an EMPTY coach-bios section with no coaches listed.
